landing.whyChoose: Why Families Choose ICE Alarm España
landing.whyChooseDesc: More than just an alarm button. Our 24/7 monitoring service combines instant response with real-time technology — designed specifically for life in Spain.
landing.featureMonitoringDesc: When you call or press your SOS button, our monitoring service responds — instantly, in your language, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. No waiting on hold, no automated menus. Just calm, capable help when you need it.

faq.testPendant: How do I test my pendant?
faq.testPendantAnswer: Press and hold the SOS button for 3 seconds. Our team will answer and confirm your device is working correctly. We recommend testing your pendant once a month.
faq.sosButton: What happens when I press the SOS button?
faq.sosButtonAnswer: When you press and hold the SOS button for 3 seconds, an alert is sent to our 24/7 monitoring center. A trained operator will immediately speak to you through your pendant and coordinate any necessary assistance.
faq.fallDetectionAnswer: Your pendant contains sensors that can detect sudden movements consistent with a fall. If a fall is detected, an automatic alert is sent to our team. We'll call through your pendant to check on you, and if there's no response, we'll follow your emergency protocol.
faq.geoFencingAnswer: Geo-fencing creates a virtual boundary around a location (like your home). If you travel outside this boundary, an alert can be sent to designated contacts. This is useful for added peace of mind for you and your family.
faq.chargePendant: How do I charge my pendant?
faq.chargePendantAnswer: Place your pendant on the charging cradle provided. A full charge takes about 2 hours and lasts up to 5 days. We recommend charging it every night before bed so it's always ready.
faq.pendantWet: What if my pendant gets wet?
faq.pendantWetAnswer: Your pendant is water-resistant (IP67 rated), so it's safe in the shower or rain. However, avoid submerging it in deep water such as a bath or swimming pool. If it gets very wet, dry it with a soft cloth.
faq.updateMedical: How do I update my medical information?
faq.updateMedicalAnswer: Go to 'Medical Info' in your dashboard and click 'Edit'. You can update your blood type, allergies, medications, conditions, and doctor information directly. Changes are saved immediately.
faq.addContacts: How do I add emergency contacts?
faq.addContactsAnswer: Go to 'Emergency Contacts' in your dashboard and click 'Add Contact'. You can add up to 3 emergency contacts with their name, phone, and relationship. You can also edit or delete contacts anytime.
faq.changePassword: How do I change my password?
faq.changePasswordAnswer: Go to 'My Account' in your dashboard and look for the password section. Click 'Change Password', enter your current password and your new one. If you've forgotten your password, use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
faq.updateAddress: How do I update my address?
faq.updateAddressAnswer: Contact our support team through the Messages tab or AI assistant to update your address. This ensures your emergency profile and geo-fencing settings are kept accurate.
faq.viewSubscription: How do I view my subscription details?
faq.viewSubscriptionAnswer: Your subscription information is shown on your dashboard homepage. You can see your plan type, renewal date, and payment status. For detailed billing history, contact our support team.
faq.updatePayment: How do I update my payment method?
faq.updatePaymentAnswer: Contact our support team through the Messages tab to update your payment details securely. We'll guide you through the process to ensure your subscription continues without interruption.
faq.billingDate: When am I billed each month?
faq.billingDateAnswer: You are billed on the same date each month as when you first subscribed. If that date doesn't exist in a shorter month, you'll be billed on the last day. You can check your next billing date on your dashboard.
faq.cancelSubscription: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.cancelSubscriptionAnswer: We're sorry to see you go. You can cancel at any time — there is no minimum term and no notice period. Cancel from your dashboard, message us here, or call us. Your monitoring stays active until the end of the billing period you have already paid for. You keep your pendant, because you bought it — but once monitoring ends the SOS button no longer reaches our team. If you joined less than 14 days ago, your right of withdrawal applies instead and you get a full refund — see section 9.2 of our Terms.
faq.medicalPrivacy: Who can see my medical information?
faq.medicalPrivacyAnswer: Your medical information is only accessible to our trained emergency operators and the emergency services we coordinate with during an alert. It is never shared with third parties for marketing or other purposes. You control what information you add.
faq.locationData: How is my location data used?
faq.locationDataAnswer: Your location is only accessed when you trigger an SOS alert or if geo-fencing is enabled. This helps emergency services find you quickly. Location data is encrypted, stored securely, and never sold or shared for advertising.

testPendant.question: How do I test my pendant?
testPendant.answer: Press and hold the SOS button for 3 seconds. Our team will answer and confirm your device is working correctly. We recommend testing your pendant once a month.

sosButton.answer: When you press and hold the SOS button for 3 seconds, an alert is sent to our 24/7 monitoring center. A trained operator will immediately speak to you through your pendant and coordinate any necessary assistance.

fallDetection.question: How does fall detection work?
fallDetection.answer: Your pendant contains sensors that can detect sudden movements consistent with a fall. If a fall is detected, an automatic alert is sent to our team. We'll call through your pendant to check on you, and if there's no response, we'll follow your emergency protocol.

geoFencing.question: What is geo-fencing?
geoFencing.answer: Geo-fencing creates a virtual boundary around a location (like your home). If you travel outside this boundary, an alert can be sent to designated contacts. This is useful for added peace of mind for you and your family.

updateMedical.question: How do I update my medical information?
updateMedical.answer: Go to the 'Medical Info' section in your dashboard. Click 'Request Update' and describe the changes you'd like to make. Our team will review and update your records within 24-48 hours.

addContacts.question: How do I add emergency contacts?
addContacts.answer: Go to 'Emergency Contacts' in your dashboard. You can add up to 3 emergency contacts. These are the people we'll call if we can't reach you during an emergency.

updatePayment.question: How do I update my payment method?
updatePayment.answer: Go to 'Subscription & Billing' in your dashboard. Click 'Update' next to your payment method to securely update your card details.

lostPendant.question: What if my pendant is lost or damaged?
lostPendant.answer: Contact us immediately! We can disable your old pendant and send you a replacement. There may be a replacement fee depending on the circumstances. Call us or use the contact form below.

upgradePlan.question: Can I upgrade from Single to Couple membership?
upgradePlan.answer: Yes! Contact our support team and we'll help you upgrade your membership. The prorated difference will be charged to your payment method on file.

faq.q4: Can I speak English with your call centre?
faq.a4: Absolutely! All our operators speak both English and Spanish fluently.
faq.q5: What if I don't want a pendant?

Holding Period: the period described in clause 8.3 during which a Commission is not yet payable.

Data Protection Law: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD) and any other applicable data protection rules.

object.title: OBJECT OF THE AGREEMENT
object.content:
3.1 THE PARTNER may introduce potential customers to THE COMPANY's personal emergency alarm service, and THE COMPANY will pay a Commission for each Qualifying Referral on the terms of this Agreement.

3.2 The relationship is non-exclusive for both parties. THE PARTNER may promote other products and services, and THE COMPANY may work with other partners, in any area. No territory or group of customers is reserved to THE PARTNER.

3.3 THE PARTNER has no minimum target and no obligation to generate any particular number of referrals.

3.4 Every customer contracts directly with THE COMPANY under THE COMPANY's own terms of service. THE PARTNER is not a party to those contracts.

status.title: INDEPENDENT STATUS OF THE PARTNER
status.content:
4.1 THE PARTNER acts independently, in its own name, with its own means and organisation and at its own risk. Nothing in this Agreement creates an employment relationship, a partnership, a joint venture or a franchise.

4.2 The parties intend this to be a non-exclusive referral arrangement and not a commercial agency contract under Law 12/1992 on Agency Contracts. THE PARTNER has no authority to negotiate or conclude contracts, accept orders, collect payments, grant discounts or make any commitment on behalf of THE COMPANY. If a court or authority finds that mandatory rules of that Law or of any other law apply, those rules prevail over any clause of this Agreement that contradicts them.

4.3 THE PARTNER is solely responsible for its own tax and social security obligations (including any registration as self-employed that the law requires), for its other legal obligations and for its own costs. THE COMPANY does not reimburse expenses unless it has agreed to do so in writing in advance.

attribution.title: REFERRAL ATTRIBUTION
attribution.content:
5.1 A registration is attributed to THE PARTNER only if the person completes registration on THE COMPANY's website after arriving through THE PARTNER's Referral Link or with its Referral Code, or after receiving an Invitation sent at THE PARTNER's request, and THE PARTNER's account is active at the time of registration.

5.2 When the Referral Link is used, the Referral Code is stored in the visitor's browser until registration. A tracked campaign link remains valid for 30 days from the click. Attribution may fail if the person uses another device or browser, blocks or deletes browser storage, or registers through another channel without the Referral Code. In those cases THE COMPANY will consider a reasoned request from THE PARTNER in good faith, but is not obliged to attribute the registration.

5.3 The first referral prevails. If the browser already holds another partner's Referral Code, or the person has already been attributed to a partner, the earlier referral prevails. Each Referred Member is attributed to one partner only.

5.4 No attribution arises for: (a) THE PARTNER itself, its staff or anyone registering on its behalf or at its expense; (b) a person who is, or has been, a customer of THE COMPANY; (c) any registration obtained in breach of this Agreement.

5.5 THE PARTNER can see the Referred Members attributed to it in the Portal. Commissions are calculated from THE COMPANY's records. THE PARTNER may dispute those records in writing within 60 days of the relevant Commission appearing, or failing to appear, in the Portal, and the parties will review the dispute in good faith.

obligations.title: PARTNER OBLIGATIONS
obligations.content:
6.1 THE PARTNER shall:
• act honestly, professionally and in good faith, and comply with all applicable laws;
• keep its details (including bank details and tax status) accurate and up to date in the Portal;
• describe THE COMPANY's service accurately, using only the information and materials published or approved by THE COMPANY;
• direct every prospective customer to THE COMPANY's website or team to contract, and never collect money, bank or card details, health information or identity documents from them;
• make clear, whenever it recommends the service, that it may receive a commission from THE COMPANY;
• respect every person's free decision, never pressure anyone to subscribe (especially older or vulnerable people), and not register anyone on their behalf unless THE COMPANY has expressly authorised it for that person;
• only ask THE COMPANY to send an Invitation to a person who has asked for it or agreed to it;
• inform THE COMPANY promptly of any complaint, incident or claim about the service that comes to its attention.

6.2 If THE PARTNER is a healthcare professional or provider, a pharmacy, a care provider or an insurer, it shall also comply with the ethical and regulatory rules of its profession or sector, including any rules on incentives, conflicts of interest and information to patients or clients, and shall not recommend the service where those rules do not allow it. THE COMPANY may decline or end a partnership if it considers that a commission could conflict with those rules.

marketing.title: ADVERTISING AND MARKETING RULES
marketing.content:
7.1 THE PARTNER shall not make any statement about the service that THE COMPANY has not published or approved. In particular, THE PARTNER shall not:
• present the service or the pendant as a medical device, a medical or health-monitoring service, or a substitute for medical care or for the 112 emergency number;
• claim that the service detects, diagnoses, prevents or treats any illness or condition, or that it guarantees any result;
• promise any response time, availability, price, discount, gift, refund or guarantee other than what THE COMPANY's website states at the time;
• make misleading, comparative or disparaging statements about THE COMPANY or its competitors.

7.2 THE PARTNER shall not send unsolicited commercial emails, SMS, WhatsApp or other electronic messages (Law 34/2002, LSSI-CE, article 21), make commercial calls in breach of telecommunications or consumer protection rules, or use spam, bulk messaging, purchased contact lists, fake reviews or misleading social media content.

7.3 Without THE COMPANY's prior written consent, THE PARTNER shall not bid on THE COMPANY's brand names in paid search advertising, register domain names, social media accounts or app names that contain them, or present itself as THE COMPANY or as its official representative.

7.4 Any advertisement, website or post that mentions THE COMPANY must be identifiable as advertising where the law requires it (including Law 34/1988, General Advertising Law, Law 3/1991 on Unfair Competition and, where applicable, the rules on influencer marketing) and must disclose THE PARTNER's commercial relationship with THE COMPANY.

7.5 THE COMPANY may ask THE PARTNER to correct or withdraw any material that does not comply with this clause, and THE PARTNER shall do so within 48 hours of the request.

commissions.title: COMMISSION
commissions.content:
8.1 THE COMPANY will pay THE PARTNER a Commission of €50 (fifty euros) for each Qualifying Referral. The amount is the same for every type of partner, does not depend on volume and is paid once per Referred Member: renewals, later orders, replacement or additional devices and couple subscriptions do not give rise to any further Commission.

8.2 A referral becomes a Qualifying Referral when all of the following are met: (a) the registration is attributed to THE PARTNER under clause 5; (b) the Referred Member has paid for the subscription; (c) delivery of the Referred Member's first pendant has been recorded; and (d) at the end of the Holding Period, the Referred Member's account is active, the order has not been cancelled and the payment has not been refunded.

8.3 A Commission is created when delivery of the pendant is recorded and remains on hold for 7 days (the Holding Period). At the end of that period it is approved or cancelled according to clause 8.2(d).

8.4 The Commission amount excludes VAT. If THE PARTNER must charge Spanish VAT (IVA) or another indirect tax on its services, that tax is added on THE PARTNER's valid invoice. Any personal income tax (IRPF) withholding that Spanish law requires THE COMPANY to make is deducted from the Commission and paid to the Tax Agency on THE PARTNER's behalf.

8.5 The Commission is a fixed amount and does not depend on the price paid by the customer, so discounts, the VAT charged to the customer and the billing period chosen do not change it.

8.6 Commissions may accrue before THE PARTNER has signed this Agreement electronically in the Portal, but they will not be paid until it has.

clawback.title: CANCELLATIONS, REFUNDS AND RECOVERY OF COMMISSIONS
clawback.content:
9.1 Customers have a statutory right to withdraw from their contract within 14 days, counted from the day they receive the pendant, and may also cancel or be refunded in other cases provided by law or by THE COMPANY's terms. Because the Holding Period is shorter than the withdrawal period, a Commission may be approved or paid before the withdrawal period has ended.

9.2 If, within 30 days of delivery of the pendant, the Referred Member withdraws from the contract, the order is cancelled, or the payment is refunded or reversed, the Commission is not due. If it has not yet been paid, THE COMPANY will cancel it. If it has been paid, THE COMPANY may set the amount off against later Commissions or, if no Commission becomes payable within 90 days, ask THE PARTNER to repay it within 30 days of the request.

9.3 A Commission is also not due, and may be recovered in the same way, if the registration was obtained through fraud, false information, self-referral or any breach of clauses 6 or 7.

9.4 Whenever an amount is recovered or set off, the corresponding corrective invoice will be issued and any VAT and withholding will be adjusted.

payment.title: PAYMENT, INVOICING AND TAXES
payment.content:
10.1 Approved Commissions are paid monthly by bank transfer to the IBAN recorded in the Portal, no later than the last day of the month following the month in which they were approved, provided that the conditions of this clause are met. Each party bears the charges of its own bank.

10.2 THE PARTNER shall provide, and keep up to date in the Portal, its full name or company name, NIF/NIE/CIF, tax address, VAT status and account holder name. The account must be held by THE PARTNER. THE COMPANY may postpone payment until it has the information it needs to pay lawfully.

10.3 If THE PARTNER acts as a business or professional, it shall issue to THE COMPANY, for each payment, an invoice that complies with the Spanish Invoicing Regulation (Royal Decree 1619/2012), showing any VAT and IRPF withholding. The parties may agree in writing that THE COMPANY issues those invoices on THE PARTNER's behalf (self-billing). If THE PARTNER is a private individual who is not required to invoice, THE COMPANY will issue a payment statement and apply any withholding the law requires.

10.4 THE PARTNER is solely responsible for declaring its Commissions and for paying the taxes and social security contributions due on them. THE COMPANY will report payments to the Tax Agency where the law requires it.

10.5 THE COMPANY may withhold payment while this Agreement has not been signed in the Portal, while THE PARTNER's account is suspended, or while a reasonable suspicion of fraud or breach is being investigated. THE COMPANY will tell THE PARTNER the reason and will complete any investigation within 60 days.

10.6 The Portal shows the status of each Commission (on hold, approved, paid or cancelled). THE COMPANY will explain the reason for any cancellation on request.

intellectualProperty.title: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
intellectualProperty.content:
11.1 THE COMPANY's names, trade marks, logos, website content, images and marketing materials belong to THE COMPANY or its licensors.

11.2 THE COMPANY grants THE PARTNER a free, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable licence to use the materials made available in the Portal, without alteration, solely to promote the service under this Agreement and in line with any brand guidelines THE COMPANY provides.

11.3 THE PARTNER shall not alter the materials, combine THE COMPANY's brands with other signs, or register or use any sign that could be confused with them.

11.4 The licence ends automatically when this Agreement ends. THE PARTNER shall then stop using the materials and remove them within 7 days.

11.5 Where THE PARTNER is an organisation, THE COMPANY may name it as a partner in its communications, unless THE PARTNER objects in writing.

confidentiality.title: CONFIDENTIALITY
confidentiality.content:
12.1 Each party shall keep confidential any non-public information it receives from the other in connection with this Agreement (including personal data, business plans, unpublished prices, Portal content and any conditions agreed individually) and shall use it only to perform this Agreement.

12.2 This obligation does not apply to information that is or becomes public without breach, that the receiving party already held lawfully, or that must be disclosed by law or by order of a court or authority (in which case, where lawful, the other party will be informed first).

12.3 The terms of this Agreement as published by THE COMPANY, including the Commission in clause 8, are not confidential.

12.4 This clause continues for 3 years after this Agreement ends, and without time limit for personal data.

dataProtection.title: DATA PROTECTION
dataProtection.content:
13.1 Each party shall comply with Data Protection Law. Each party is an independent controller of the personal data it processes for its own purposes. This Agreement does not make either party a processor of the other; if processing on behalf of the other party is ever needed, the parties will first sign a data processing agreement under article 28 GDPR.

13.2 THE PARTNER's data. THE COMPANY processes the personal data of THE PARTNER or its contact persons (identification, contact, bank and tax details, Portal activity, referral and commission records, and the records of acceptance and signature of this Agreement) to manage the partnership, pay Commissions, meet its accounting and tax obligations and prevent fraud. The legal bases are the performance of this Agreement and compliance with legal obligations. More information, including how to exercise data protection rights, is in THE COMPANY's Privacy Policy. Contact: privacy@icealarm.es.

13.3 Data THE PARTNER can see. In the Portal THE PARTNER can see the name, registration date and status of its Referred Members and the status of the related Commissions. Where THE COMPANY has enabled alert notifications for a care organisation in respect of a person in its care, with that person's authorisation or on another lawful basis, the organisation may also see information about that person's alerts (such as type, time, status and location). THE PARTNER shall use this information only for the purpose for which it is provided, shall not export, copy or disclose it beyond what is strictly necessary, shall protect it with appropriate security measures, and shall not use it for its own marketing.

13.4 Data THE PARTNER passes on. Before asking THE COMPANY to send an Invitation, or passing on anyone's details in any other way, THE PARTNER shall make sure that the person has asked for or agreed to be contacted by THE COMPANY and knows that THE PARTNER is sharing their details with it. THE PARTNER shall never pass on health information about anyone.

13.5 THE PARTNER shall notify THE COMPANY at privacy@icealarm.es without undue delay, and in any case within 24 hours of becoming aware of it, of any security incident affecting personal data received from THE COMPANY, and shall cooperate in managing it.

13.6 When this Agreement ends, THE PARTNER shall delete the personal data received from THE COMPANY, unless the law requires it to keep them, and shall confirm the deletion in writing on request.

duration.title: DURATION
duration.content: This Agreement takes effect when THE PARTNER accepts it during registration and continues for an indefinite period until it is terminated under clause 15. THE PARTNER's electronic signature in the Portal confirms that acceptance and is required before any Commission is paid (clause 8.6).

termination.title: TERMINATION
termination.content:
15.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, without giving reasons, by written notice to the other (including by email or through the Portal) given at least 30 days in advance, or any longer period required by mandatory law.

15.2 THE COMPANY may suspend THE PARTNER's account, or terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by written notice, if THE PARTNER seriously or repeatedly breaches this Agreement (in particular clauses 6, 7, 12 or 13), acts fraudulently, harms THE COMPANY's reputation or its customers' interests, or becomes insolvent. THE PARTNER may terminate with immediate effect if THE COMPANY seriously breaches its payment obligations and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of being notified.

15.3 On termination: (a) Commissions already approved are paid under clause 10, unless the termination is due to THE PARTNER's fraud or serious breach in connection with them; (b) a registration attributed to THE PARTNER before the termination date that becomes a Qualifying Referral within 30 days after that date still gives rise to a Commission; (c) THE PARTNER's access to the Portal and its Referral Links end, and THE PARTNER shall stop presenting itself as a partner; (d) clauses 9, 11.4, 12, 13, 16 and 18 continue to apply.

liability.title: LIABILITY
liability.content:
16.1 Each party is liable for the damage it causes to the other by breaching this Agreement, in accordance with the Spanish Civil Code.

16.2 THE PARTNER shall indemnify THE COMPANY against any claims, penalties and reasonable costs (including legal fees) arising from THE PARTNER's breach of clauses 6, 7, 11 or 13 or from any unlawful act of THE PARTNER when promoting the service.

16.3 THE COMPANY is not liable for THE PARTNER's loss of profit, or for Commissions not earned because of the technical limits of attribution described in clause 5.2, interruptions of the Portal, or a customer's decision not to subscribe or to cancel. THE COMPANY's total liability to THE PARTNER under this Agreement in any 12-month period is limited to the total Commissions payable to THE PARTNER in that period.

16.4 Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes liability for wilful misconduct (dolo) or gross negligence, for personal injury, or any other liability that cannot be limited under Spanish law, nor THE COMPANY's obligation to pay Commissions that are properly due.

amendments.title: CHANGES TO THIS AGREEMENT
amendments.content:
17.1 THE COMPANY may amend this Agreement, including the Commission amount and conditions, by notifying THE PARTNER by email and in the Portal at least 30 days before the change takes effect. Each version has a version number, and THE COMPANY records which version THE PARTNER has accepted.

17.2 If THE PARTNER does not agree with a change, it may terminate this Agreement, without penalty, before the change takes effect. If THE PARTNER remains in the programme after that date, the change applies to it, and THE COMPANY may ask THE PARTNER to accept or sign the new version in the Portal.

17.3 A change never affects the Commission for a registration attributed before the change takes effect; that registration remains subject to the terms in force when it was attributed.

17.4 THE COMPANY may make changes required by law, or changes that do not reduce THE PARTNER's rights, with immediate effect, informing THE PARTNER as soon as reasonably possible.

17.5 Any other change or waiver must be agreed in writing (including electronically) by both parties.

jurisdiction.title: APPLICABLE LAW AND JURISDICTION
jurisdiction.content:
18.1 This Agreement is governed by Spanish law.

18.2 The parties will first try to resolve any dispute amicably. THE PARTNER may write to info@icealarm.es for this purpose.

18.3 If no agreement is reached, disputes shall be submitted to the courts of Almería (Spain), unless mandatory law entitles THE PARTNER to bring or defend proceedings before the courts of its own domicile (for example, where THE PARTNER acts as a consumer or the rules on agency contracts apply), in which case that right is respected.

general.title: GENERAL PROVISIONS
general.content:
19.1 This Agreement, together with any conditions THE COMPANY agrees individually and in writing with THE PARTNER, is the entire agreement between the parties on the partner programme and replaces any earlier version or communication on the same subject, without affecting Commissions already accrued.

19.2 If any clause is held invalid, the remaining clauses stay in force and the invalid clause will be replaced by a valid one as close as possible to the parties' intention.

19.3 THE PARTNER may not assign or subcontract this Agreement or its Referral Links without THE COMPANY's written consent. THE COMPANY may assign this Agreement to a company in its group or to a successor to its business, informing THE PARTNER.

19.4 Notices are sent to the email address recorded in the Portal for THE PARTNER, and to info@icealarm.es for THE COMPANY.

19.5 Acceptance and record. THE PARTNER accepts this Agreement electronically by ticking the acceptance box during registration, and THE COMPANY records the date and time of acceptance and the version accepted. THE PARTNER then confirms it by electronic signature in the Portal, and THE COMPANY keeps a record of that signature (name, identity document, date and time, version and the text signed). Electronic acceptance and signature are valid under Regulation (EU) 910/2014 (eIDAS) and Law 34/2002 (LSSI-CE). THE PARTNER can read the current version at any time at icealarm.es/partner/terms and the version it signed in the Portal.

19.6 This Agreement is available in Spanish and English. If the versions differ, the Spanish version prevails.

cancellation.company: ICE Alarm España S.L. · Tax ID (CIF) B24731531

cancellation.draftNotice: This policy is a draft pending legal review. It does not limit any right you have under Spanish or EU consumer law; where it appears to, the law prevails.
summaryItems: You can withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason and receive a full refund of what you paid.
After that you can cancel at any time, with no minimum term and no notice period. Monitoring continues until the end of the period you have already paid for.
The pendant is yours to keep when you cancel. It only comes back to us if you withdraw within the 14 days.
Refunds are made within 14 days, to the same payment method you used.
Once monitoring ends, the SOS button no longer reaches our team.
cancellation.s1Title: 1. Who we are and who this policy applies to
cancellation.s1p1: This policy is provided by ICE Alarm España S.L. (CIF B24731531), registered office at [[TO CONFIRM: registered address]], email info@icealarm.es, telephone [[TO CONFIRM: customer service telephone and hours]]. It forms part of our Terms of Service and explains how you can withdraw from, cancel and obtain refunds for your membership and your GPS pendant.
cancellation.s1p2: It applies to you if you are a consumer — a person acting for purposes outside their trade, business or profession — and you took out your membership at a distance (online or by telephone) or away from our business premises.
cancellation.s2p1: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 calendar days without giving any reason and without any penalty (Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007, articles 102 to 108).
s2Items: If you ordered a pendant, the 14 days start on the day you, or a person you nominate other than the carrier, take physical possession of it. If pendants ordered together arrive on different days, the period starts when you receive the last one.
If you took out a membership without a pendant, the 14 days start on the day the contract was concluded.
To exercise it, tell us of your decision by a clear statement before the period ends, using any of the channels in section 3. You may use the model form in section 15, but you do not have to.
You are in time if you send your statement before the 14 days are up, even if it reaches us afterwards.
We recommend keeping a copy of your message. We will always confirm that we have received it.
cancellation.s3p1: Withdrawing or cancelling should be as easy as joining. Use whichever channel suits you:
s3Items: Online: [[TO CONFIRM: online withdrawal and cancellation function in the member area — not yet available]]
By email: write to info@icealarm.es, ideally from the email address you registered with, giving your name and saying that you wish to withdraw or to cancel.
From your member area: send us a message from the Support section.
By telephone: [[TO CONFIRM: customer service telephone and hours]].
By post: ICE Alarm España S.L., [[TO CONFIRM: registered address]].
cancellation.s3p2: We will send you an acknowledgement by email without delay, stating what you asked for and the date and time we received it. If you do not receive it, please contact us again so that your request is not lost.
cancellation.s3p3: If you are acting for a member who cannot do it themselves, please tell us who you are and your relationship to the member. We may need to check that you are authorised to act for them.
s4Items: We refund every payment we received from you under the contract: the membership fee, the pendant, the registration fee and the cost of standard delivery. If you chose a delivery method more expensive than our standard one, we refund the standard cost.
We make the refund without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day we are informed of your decision.
We use the same means of payment you used for the original transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise. You will not be charged any fee for the refund.
For the pendant, we may withhold the corresponding part of the refund until we have received it back, or until you have given us evidence that you have sent it, whichever is earlier.
If monitoring started during the withdrawal period at your express request, we deduct only the proportionate amount described in section 5.
If someone else paid on your behalf, the refund goes back to the payment method that was charged.
cancellation.s5Title: 5. If monitoring started during the withdrawal period
cancellation.s5p1: Our monitoring service may start before the 14 days are over only if you expressly ask us to start it. If you asked for this and then withdraw, you pay an amount proportionate to the service provided until you told us you were withdrawing.
s5Items: How it is calculated: the price of your current billing period (IVA included), divided by the number of days in that period, multiplied by the number of days monitoring was active until you told us you were withdrawing.
For an annual membership, the same calculation is made on the annual price over 365 days.

If you did not expressly ask for monitoring to start during the withdrawal period, or we did not give you this information before you contracted, you owe nothing for the service provided during that period.
Everything you paid above that amount is refunded as described in section 4.
s6Items: Send the pendant back without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day you told us you were withdrawing, to: [[TO CONFIRM: returns address]].
You pay the direct cost of returning the pendant. It can be sent by ordinary post or courier. [[TO CONFIRM: estimated return cost]]
You are only liable for any loss in value caused by handling the pendant beyond what is necessary to establish its nature, characteristics and functioning.
Please include the charger and any accessories supplied with it, and a note with your name or order number so that we can match the parcel to your refund.
When we process your withdrawal we disconnect the pendant from our service. From then on, pressing its SOS button no longer reaches our team.
s7Items: You can cancel your membership at any time. There is no minimum term and no notice period.
Your cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period you have already paid for. Monitoring continues until then, and you will not be charged again.

Once the withdrawal period is over, fees already paid for the current billing period are not refunded. This also applies to annual memberships. [[TO CONFIRM: treatment of annual memberships cancelled early — pending legal review]]
You keep the pendant, because you bought it. There is nothing to return.
When monitoring ends, the SOS button no longer reaches our team. If you still need an alarm service, please arrange an alternative before that date.
We confirm your cancellation, and the date it takes effect, by email.
We keep your personal data only as described in our Privacy Policy.
s8Items: Monthly memberships renew automatically every month, and annual memberships every 12 months, until you cancel.
An annual membership costs the same as 10 months at the monthly price, paid in one instalment for 12 months of service.

Your membership renews at the price in force on the renewal date. We tell you at least 30 days before any price change takes effect; if you do not accept it, you can cancel before it applies, at no cost.
[[TO CONFIRM: reminder sent before an annual renewal — not currently sent]]
Your next renewal date is shown in your member area, under Membership.
s9Items: Every price shown to you before you pay includes IVA (Spanish VAT) where it applies.
The GPS pendant is sold to you and carries IVA at 21%.
Delivery is charged once per order, however many pendants you order.
A one-off registration fee may apply, as shown in the order summary. [[TO CONFIRM: IVA treatment of the registration fee]]

privacy.s4p1: Where we rely on legitimate interest, you may object at any time (section 11). If we are required to give you information or keep records by law, we do so because of that legal obligation.
privacy.s5Title: 5. Your health information and your explicit consent
privacy.s5p1: Health information is special category data. We only hold it because you give us your explicit consent, separately from accepting our Terms. You give it with its own tick box when you sign up, and we ask for your health details only after sign-up.
privacy.s5Intro: With your consent we use your health information only to:
s5Items: show it to our operators when you have an alert or call us, so they understand your situation;
give the relevant parts to 112, ambulance crews or hospital staff who are helping you;
share it with a family member or carer only if you have allowed that person to see your medical information.
privacy.s5p2: We never use your health information for marketing, never sell it, and never use it to make decisions about your contract or price.
privacy.s5p3: Withdrawing consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to privacy@icealarm.es or by calling us. We will then delete your health information. Your alarm will keep working and our operators will still answer, but they will not know your medical background, so the help they can give may be less informed. Withdrawing consent does not affect what we did before.
privacy.s5p4: In an emergency. If you are physically or legally unable to give consent and your life or health is at risk, we may share the information we hold with emergency services to protect your vital interests.
privacy.s5p5: If you cannot give consent yourself. Every member must give their own consent — on a couple membership, each person gives their own. At present a relative or representative cannot give consent on a member's behalf through our website. If this applies to you, please contact us so we can discuss what is possible. [[TO CONFIRM: position for legal representatives, pending legal advice]]
privacy.s6Title: 6. Isabella, our AI assistant, and automated decisions
privacy.s6p1: Isabella is an artificial-intelligence assistant. She is not a person, and she tells you so. She can answer questions in our website chat, in your account and on some phone calls, help you with your account, and write notes for our operators.
s6Items: gives medical advice or a diagnosis;
decides whether an alert is real, how serious it is, or closes an emergency — every SOS goes to a human operator;
invents or changes a health reading;
sees more of your information than your own account allows.
privacy.s6p2: When Isabella is unsure, she hands over to a person. You can ask to speak to a person at any time.
privacy.s6p3: We do not take any decision based solely on automated processing that has legal or similarly significant effects on you (article 22 GDPR). Decisions about emergencies, your membership and your payments are taken or checked by people.
privacy.s6p4: To generate Isabella's replies, the content of your conversation is sent to our AI provider, Anthropic, PBC (United States), which processes it on our behalf (sections 7 and 8). [[TO CONFIRM: Anthropic data processing terms and retention period]]
privacy.s7Title: 7. Who we share your data with
privacy.s7Intro: We only share what each recipient needs.

privacy.s10Intro: We use technical and organisational measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the data, including:
s10Items: encrypted connections (HTTPS) between your browser, our systems and our providers;
encryption of stored data provided by our hosting provider;
database rules (row-level security) so that each person can only reach the records they are allowed to see;
role-based access for staff, with two-factor authentication for administrative access;
audit records of changes to member records and of permissions given to family members or carers;
masking of on-screen text in website error reports;
contracts with every service provider that handles your data.
privacy.s10p1: No system is completely secure. If a personal data breach is likely to put your rights at risk, we will notify the AEPD within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, and if the risk to you is high we will also tell you without undue delay.

cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains which cookies and similar technologies are used on icealarm.es and in the ICE Alarm España member, partner and staff portals, what they are for, how long they last and how you can accept, refuse or withdraw your consent at any time. It complements our Privacy Policy, which explains how we process personal data in general.
cookies.s1Title: 1. What are cookies and similar technologies?
cookies.s1p1: Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device. Websites can also store information in your browser in other ways — for example “local storage” (which remains until it is deleted) and “session storage” (which is deleted when you close the tab or browser). The Spanish Information Society Services Act (Ley 34/2002, LSSI-CE, article 22.2) applies to all of these technologies in the same way, so in this policy we call them all “cookies”.
cookies.s1p2: Some cookies are strictly necessary for a service you have asked for, and can be used without your consent. All other cookies are only used if you agree to them.
cookies.s2p1: The cookies described here are set by ICE Alarm España S.L. (CIF B24731531), except where a third-party provider is named in the table. You can contact us about this policy at privacy@icealarm.es.
s3Items: Strictly necessary: to sign you in and keep your session secure, to remember your cookie choice, to keep a form you are filling in and to detect errors. They cannot be switched off, because the website would not work without them.
Preferences: to remember choices you make, such as your language, text size or whether you have already seen a guided tour. They are only stored when you make that choice.
Analytics (only with your consent): our own statistics about which pages are visited and from what kind of device, so we can improve the website. They are not shared with advertisers.
Marketing: we do not currently use advertising or social-media cookies. If we ever do, they will only be used with your consent and this policy will be updated first.

cookies.s6Title: 6. How to accept, refuse or withdraw consent
cookies.s6p1: When you first visit, a banner lets you accept all cookies, reject all non-essential cookies, or choose by category. Rejecting is as easy as accepting, and no optional category is switched on in advance.
cookies.s6p2: You can change your mind at any time using “Cookie settings” at the bottom of our pages, the button below or, if you are a member, the Privacy & Data section of your account. When you withdraw consent for analytics, we stop collecting statistics straight away and delete the analytics identifiers from your browser. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything done before.
cookies.s6BrowsersIntro: You can also block or delete cookies and stored data in your browser settings. If you block strictly necessary cookies, parts of the website — such as signing in — will not work.
s6Browsers: Google Chrome: Settings › Privacy and security › Third-party cookies / Site data
Mozilla Firefox: Settings › Privacy & Security › Cookies and Site Data
Safari: Settings › Safari › Advanced › Website Data
Microsoft Edge: Settings › Cookies and site permissions
cookies.s7p1: Some of the providers named above (such as Sentry and Google) are based outside the European Economic Area. Where their technologies involve a transfer of personal data, it is made under the safeguards described in our Privacy Policy.
cookies.s8p1: We will update this policy if the cookies we use change. If a change requires your consent again, the banner will ask you again the next time you visit. The date and version at the top show when it was last changed.
cookies.s9p1: For any question about cookies or your personal data, write to privacy@icealarm.es. You also have the right to complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, www.aepd.es).

meta.title: How It Works — From SOS to Safety in Minutes

hero.badge: From button press to safety — a real scenario
hero.title: What Really Happens
hero.subtitle: Meet Maria, 78, who lives alone in her villa in Alicante. Her daughter Sarah lives in London. One Tuesday morning, Maria slips in her kitchen...

step1.title: The Alert
step1.description: Maria presses the SOS button on her pendant. Instantly, two things happen:
step1.voicePath: A two-way voice channel opens through her pendant
step1.dataPath: Her alert lands on our 24/7 call-centre screen with her profile — name, age, address, medical conditions, emergency contacts, preferred language
step1.note: Even if Maria had fallen and couldn't press the button, the built-in fall detection would have triggered the alert automatically.

step2.title: A Real Person Answers
step2.description: A calm human voice comes through the pendant — Ana, one of our call-centre team:
step2.responseQuote: "Hola Maria, le habla ICE Alarm España. Estoy aquí con usted. ¿Qué ha pasado?"
step2.responseQuoteTranslation: ("Hello Maria, this is ICE Alarm España. I'm here with you. What happened?")
step2.detail1: Ana sees Maria prefers Spanish before she says a word — so Maria is greeted in her own language
step2.detail2: No menus, no hold music, no robot — a real person, using her name, calm and reassuring
step2.detail3: Maria isn't on hold. She has a person with her from the first moment.

step3.title: The Right Questions
step3.description: Ana asks Maria what happened. Maria says she slipped and her hip hurts.
step3.detail1: Maria's medical profile is on Ana's screen — including her hip replacement two years ago
step3.detail2: So the right follow-up comes straight away: "Can you move your leg, Maria? Is it the same hip as before?"
step3.detail3: Not a generic checklist — informed questions based on what we know about Maria.
step3.note: Ana gathers the details that save time for the emergency services later — details Maria might forget to mention under stress.

step4.title: Your Team Sees Everything
step4.description: While talking with Maria, Ana has everything in front of her:
step4.detail2: Her GPS location — pinpointed to her kitchen
step4.detail4: Emergency contacts — including Sarah in London
step4.detail5: The alert itself — what triggered it, when, and from which device
step4.note: No searching, no asking Maria to spell her address. Zero wasted time.

step5.title: Help Is Arranged
step5.description: Ana decides with Maria what she needs. A fall, hip pain, and her surgical history? An ambulance — now:
step5.detail1: No handovers, no repeating her story — the same person stays with Maria throughout
step5.detail2: Ana can speak to Maria in Spanish and to the emergency services in Spanish
step5.detail3: Sarah, her daughter in London, is next on the list to be told
step5.agentQuote: "Maria, I can see exactly what's happened and I'm staying with you. I'm calling an ambulance for you right now. Stay on the line — I'm not going anywhere."
step5.note: One person, start to finish. Maria never has to explain herself twice.

step6.title: Help Is On The Way
step6.description: Ana calls the Spanish emergency services on Maria's behalf:
step6.detail1: Gives the ambulance Maria's exact GPS coordinates
step6.detail2: Explains the fall, the hip pain, and her surgical history — in Spanish
step6.detail3: Maria is never left alone — Ana stays on the pendant with her, keeping her calm
step6.responseQuote: "You're doing great, Maria. Help is already on its way. Try to stay still and we'll stay right here with you."
step6.note: The line doesn't go quiet. We stay with Maria until help physically arrives.

step7.title: Your Phone Rings
step7.subtitle: This is the moment that matters most.
step7.description: Sarah is sitting in her office in London. Her phone rings. It's ICE Alarm España.
step7.agentQuote: "Hello Sarah, this is Ana from ICE Alarm España. Your mum Maria had a fall in her kitchen a few minutes ago. She's conscious, talking, and an ambulance is on its way. She has some hip pain but she's calm — I've been speaking with her the whole time."
step7.emotionalNote: Sarah didn't find out hours later. She didn't get a missed call from a Spanish number she didn't recognise. She received a clear, calm, professional call — in English — minutes after it happened.
step7.detail1: Sarah gets connected to Maria on the pendant
step7.detail2: She can hear her mum's voice and know she's okay
step7.detail3: She knows exactly what is happening and who is helping

step8.title: Safe Hands
step8.description: The ambulance arrives. Maria is taken to hospital for checks. She's bruised but nothing is broken.
step8.detail1: Ana has briefed the ambulance crew on Maria's medical history
step8.detail3: The next day, ICE Alarm España follows up with Maria to check she's okay
step8.note: This isn't a one-time response. It's an ongoing relationship. Maria gets a follow-up call, and her incident is logged so our team knows to check on her.

whatIf.title: What If...?
whatIf.subtitle: Real concerns, real answers.
whatIf.a1: Our call-centre team still receives the alert with Maria's full profile and GPS location, and can send help immediately — no voice needed. The voice channel opens by itself, so the operator can hear what is happening in the room even if Maria cannot answer.
whatIf.q2: What if it's a false alarm?
whatIf.a2: The operator simply asks Maria. If she says she's fine, the alert is cancelled — no fuss, no charge. We'd rather you pressed it by accident a hundred times than hesitate the one time it matters.
whatIf.a3: Our call centre is staffed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Emergencies don't keep office hours — and neither do we.
whatIf.q4: What if Maria speaks English and the ambulance crew only speaks Spanish?
whatIf.a4: Our bilingual team handles the call with Spanish emergency services on Maria's behalf. She doesn't have to say a word to the paramedics if she doesn't want to — we've already briefed them.

shift_no_show.title: Somebody has not signed in for their shift
shift_no_show.body: Their shift started and they are not on duty.

shift_swap_accepted.title: A swap was accepted and needs approving
shift_swap_accepted.body: Goes to the person who asked, and to everyone who can approve it. Nothing has moved on the rota yet.

shift_swap_approved.title: A shift swap was approved
shift_swap_approved.body: Goes to both people. The rota they turn up to has changed.

shift_swap_requested.title: Somebody asked you to swap or cover a shift
shift_swap_requested.body: Goes to the person being asked. Their answer is what the requester is waiting on.

sos_opened.title: An alert was raised

sos_unassigned.title: An alert nobody has picked up
sos_unassigned.body: An open alert with no operator on it.

system_runner_failure.title: A safety runner has failed
system_runner_failure.body: The escalation or monitoring runner is not running. The SOS ladder may be down.

test.title: A test notification
test.body: Sent only by the "send a test" button, to you.

medconneqt.title: MedConneqt

medconneqt.loginNote: MedConneqt is a separate system with its own login — signing in to ICE Alarm España does not sign you in there.

addMember.subtitle: Step {{step}} of {{total}}. The member is created inactive — taking payment is what activates them.

addMember.payerExplainer: A billing relationship only. Paying for someone gives no access to their medical information, location or alerts — that needs the member’s own consent.
addMember.payerNotAttachedYet: Recorded now, and linked to the subscription when payment is taken.
addMember.whatHappens1: Creates the member record as INACTIVE. Payment is what activates them.
addMember.whatHappens2: Records the payer, if there is one. No subscription is created.
addMember.whatHappens3: Sends nothing. No email goes out — take their emergency contacts on this call.
addMember.whatHappens4: Takes you to their record so you can add contacts now.
addMember.created: Member record created. They are NOT yet active — payment activates them.
